name: M. Hammad Hassan
bio:
Hammad is a product engineer and technical consultant specializing in automation and AI, with more than five years' experience supporting clients and teams across more than 10 industries. He turns ideas, prototypes and existing systems into reliable software, and much of his work has involved modernizing legacy systems and stabilizing software that has become unreliable or hard to change. He has often been the one to pick up a technology that was new to the team, and has delivered in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go and PHP, among others, along with their related frameworks.

His focus is on automating the workflows that slow teams down, from data intake to reporting, so work gets done faster and more consistently. He prefers to build on the tools people already use, turning them into shared, tested software, and applies AI only where it fits, such as reading documents and extracting data, with every result traceable to its source. He also helps teams set the engineering standards that let automation grow beyond a single project.

Hammad has led teams of four to five engineers on SaaS products and has trained more than seven interns and junior developers. He has also contributed to IEEE educational outreach in Karachi, presenting workshops on digital tools for teaching and supporting a program that helped teachers run online classes during the Covid-19 pandemic. His background also spans software quality assurance and application security.

His rule is simple: automation should save people time, never replace their judgement.

Outside of work, Hammad enjoys sketching, reading, blogging and trying new hobbies.
